# Lab 3.3: LOAD DATA SQL Statement

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the `LOAD DATA` statement to append, overwrite, load Hive-partitioned files, and load into a temporary table.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create Hive-style folders in the bucket.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
for Y in 2019 2020; do
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = 'gs://$BUCKET/hive/names/year=$Y/part-*.parquet', format = 'PARQUET', overwrite = TRUE) AS
SELECT name, gender, state, number FROM \`bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_current\` WHERE year = $Y"
done
gcloud storage ls gs://$BUCKET/hive/names/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Append and overwrite.** Replace `YOUR_BUCKET` with your bucket name.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">LOAD DATA INTO lab03.names_sql
FROM FILES (format = 'PARQUET', uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*']);

LOAD DATA INTO lab03.names_sql
FROM FILES (format = 'PARQUET', uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*']);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab03.names_sql;   -- doubled

LOAD DATA OVERWRITE lab03.names_sql
FROM FILES (format = 'PARQUET', uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*']);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab03.names_sql;   -- back to one copy</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Load Hive-partitioned files.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">LOAD DATA OVERWRITE lab03.names_by_year
FROM FILES (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/hive/names/*'],
  hive_partition_uri_prefix = 'gs://YOUR_BUCKET/hive/names'
)
WITH PARTITION COLUMNS (year INT64);

SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM lab03.names_by_year GROUP BY year;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The `year` column comes from the folder name, not from the files.

4. **[SQL] Load into a temporary table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">LOAD DATA INTO TEMP TABLE tmp_names
FROM FILES (format = 'PARQUET', uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*']);
SELECT state, SUM(number) FROM tmp_names GROUP BY state ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Run this as one script. The temp table disappears when the script ends.

5. **[Console] Check the jobs.** In **Personal history**, each `LOAD DATA` shows as a **LOAD** job.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `LOAD DATA INTO` | Appends |
| `LOAD DATA OVERWRITE` | Replaces |
| Hive partitions | `year` column from folder names |
| Temp table | Exists only in the script session |
